description:
Send a text message via WhatsApp, Telegram (tdlib), Telegram Bot, SMS, VK/OK (notify), or MAX (max), with optional cascade fallback between channels. Supports scheduling, priority, reply-to, typing simulation, and delivery callbacks.

Use it when the user asks to text, message, notify or reply to one person or group chat. For many phone numbers use send_bulk; for documents, images, audio or video use send_file.

Recipient: `phone` is required, except for personal Telegram (dispatch_routing ["tdlib"]) where `username` or `tdlib_user_id` can be used instead, and WhatsApp where `whatsapp_lid` can be used.

Returns the delivery ID for get_delivery_status and delete_delivery.

callback_url.description: URL that receives the final delivery status as a POST request (retried every 2 minutes, up to 10 times, until it returns HTTP 200).

dispatch_routing.description: Channels in the order ChatPush should try them (cascade: the next channel is used only if delivery through the previous one fails). whatsapp = WhatsApp, tdlib = personal Telegram account, telegram = Telegram Bot, notify = VK/OK, max = MAX messenger, sms = SMS. If omitted, the account's default routing is used.

external_id.description: Your client-side ID for this message (idempotency ID).

phone.description: Recipient phone in international format, e.g. 79991234567. Optional if username/tdlib_user_id is used for tdlib.

priority.description: Sending priority. Chosen automatically if omitted.

reply_to_message_id.description: ID of the message to reply to, taken from an incoming-message webhook.

scheduled_at.description: Delayed sending time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in UTC+0. At least 1 minute and at most 1 month ahead.

sender_name.description: Registered SMS sender name (see get_balance → sender names).

simulate_typing.description: Default true: show a typing indicator in WhatsApp before sending. false sends instantly.

tdlib_user_id.description: Telegram user ID (positive = private chat, negative = group chat). tdlib channel only.

text.description: Message text. Max 3500 chars; 938 when dispatch_routing (or the account default routing) includes SMS. One SMS segment is 160 Latin characters.

username.description: Telegram username (format: username or @username). tdlib only.

whatsapp_lid.description: WhatsApp LID. Format: 43445322325 or 43445322325@lid. WhatsApp only.

name: send_message
title: Send message
